_doc: Weapon frames for the move viewer (moves.html). All vectors are in the model's own frame in metres: the GLB frame (glTF, +Y up) for files without prep, the prepAxe wrapper frame for the axe, the builder's frame for procedural weapons. grip_primary = where the primary hand's fist centre goes; shaft_axis = the primary hand's grip axis (pinky->index), unit; for melee weapons it points from the primary grip toward the business end; ref_axis = unit, perpendicular to shaft_axis: the striking face / edge for melee weapons, the saw top for the chainsaw, and toward the muzzle side for guns (guns also carry barrel_axis / up_axis, because their grip axis is not the barrel). The viewer puts ref_axis toward the fist's knuckle direction. Note: fistFrame's knuckle vector (Middle1 minus the finger-joint centroid) points mostly to the BACK of the hand, while a hammer or axe face in a natural one-handed chop points along the forearm (the punch direction), about 90 deg away; expect to need roll +/-90 for those (and per-clip roll for two-handed swings). primary_hand = which hand sits at grip_primary in the hold data sheets (tools/hold/weapons_hold.json). Measured from the GLBs by parsing the glTF node tree and mesh (2026-10-15).

packaxe.label: Axe (hospital pack)
packaxe.notes: The Hospital Survivor Weapons pack's fire axe as delivered (assets/weapons/hospital, unchanged, no prepAxe). Its own markers: GameGrip_R at the origin, GameGrip_L 22 cm up the handle, ImpactPoint on the blade at (-0.135, 0.694). GLB +Y along the handle; the blade projects toward -X (ref_axis = the blade side).

packcrowbar.label: Crowbar (hospital pack)
packcrowbar.notes: The Hospital Survivor Weapons pack's crowbar as delivered (assets/weapons/hospital, unchanged; the arena's own crowbar entry is a modified copy). Its own markers: GameGrip_R at the origin, GameGrip_L 14 cm up, ImpactPoint at the hook (-0.082, 0.423). GLB +Y along the shaft; the hook toward -X.

alubat.label: Bat (wood)
alubat.notes: The Hospital Survivor Weapons pack's aluminum bat as delivered (assets/source/weapons_in, the user's pack from ChatGPT; copied unchanged to assets/weapons/hospital). Its own markers: GameGrip_R at the origin (the knob end of the grip), GameGrip_L 9.3 cm up the grip, ImpactPoint 65.5 cm up. GLB +Y runs along the bat; it is round, so ref_axis is free. Body -7.5..76.8 cm along Y, 6.2 cm across.

golf.label: Golf club (bone)
golf.notes: The user's Bone Golf Club (2026-10-22, Downloads/Bone_Golf_Club_Asset_Pack.zip, unpacked to assets/source/golf; the GLB copied unchanged). Its own markers: Grip / CarryGrip at the origin, just under the double cap (the left, top hand of a right-handed golfer); StrikePoint (0.251, -0.88, 0.034). The shaft runs down -Y leaning +X toward the head (grip to the ankle joint at 0.135, -0.845); the head points +X and its striking face looks along +Z (ref_axis). The right hand sits 9.5 cm below the left (grip_secondary). Rig Lab only so far (the Meshy Rebel).

bat.label: Bat
bat.notes: makeBat(0.84): lathe along +Z, origin 0.13 m from the knob (knob z=-0.13, tip z=0.71). Grips from the bat hold data sheet (weapons_hold.json: Left 0.065, Right 0.14 from the knob -> z=-0.065 and z=+0.01). The game's makeBat userData.handOffset puts the hands at z=+/-0.045 instead (0.085 / 0.175 from the knob). Round: ref_axis is arbitrary (no logo/feature). impact_point = sweet spot ~0.16 m from the end (0.68 from the knob); hit zone 0.42-0.84 from the knob. Handle r 14.5 mm (tape 15.8 mm), barrel r 34 mm.

sledgehammer.label: Sledgehammer
sledgehammer.notes: GLB frame: shaft +Y (butt y=-0.145, head top y=0.705), head faces +/-X (double-faced; ref_axis = the +X face, where the GLB impact_point sits; flip for the -X face), head thickness along Z (0.105 m). Head block 0.274 x 0.147 (along shaft) x 0.105 m, centre y=0.632. Rubber grip y -0.145..0.145 (outline ~38 x 43 mm, r~20 mm at grip_primary); tan wood handle above it (~27 x 30 mm, r~14.7 mm at grip_secondary). grip_primary/GameGrip_R is 0.145 m from the butt, grip_secondary/GameGrip_L 0.310 m above it (hands far apart: a choked/sliding grip; for bat-style swings with the hands together put the second hand ~0.075 m above the first). The GLB names the back grip GameGrip_R, but primary_hand is Left here to match the bat data sheet (right-handed swing: left hand at the butt). The GLB axis_note says "local +Z follows shaft": that is the Blender empty axis; in glTF the empties have identity rotation and the shaft is +Y.

crowbar.label: Crowbar
crowbar.notes: GLB frame: straight octagonal shaft along +Y (24.4 mm across Z, 22.2 mm across X, r~12.7 mm), chisel foot at the bottom (y=-0.200, bent toward +X, 38 mm wide across Z), gooseneck hook at the top (shaft rises to y=0.500 and curls over toward -X; the claw arm comes back DOWN to its tips at about (-0.075, 0.383), pointing -Y). The V-slot splits the claw into two prongs side by side along Z; the hook curls in the X-Y plane. ref_axis = -X = the side the hook projects to; impact_point = the outermost point of the curl (x=-0.097, y=0.448), which leads in an axe-style swing with the hook forward. Secondary business end: the chisel tip (0.048, -0.200) for butt strikes/stabs. grip_primary/GameGrip_R is 0.200 m above the chisel tip; grip_secondary/GameGrip_L 0.172 m above it (optional second hand; the catalog files the crowbar as one-handed).

chainsaw.label: Chainsaw
chainsaw.notes: GLB frame: forward +X (bar), up +Y, operator's right = +Z (bar, chain and clutch cover are on the +Z side). grip_primary (GameGrip_R, origin) = centre of the upper rear grasp bar; that bar is NOT horizontal: its centreline rises 14.0 deg toward the front (y = 0.249 x), so shaft_axis = the rear-handle axis [0.970, 0.242, 0] = the right hand's pinky->index direction (index finger forward on the trigger, which is inside the front of the rear opening). Rear grasp section ~44 mm (Z) x 31 mm, r~21 mm. ref_axis = saw top (+Y) made perpendicular to the shaft axis; in the natural hold the back of the right hand is on top of the rear bar. grip_secondary (GameGrip_L) = centre of the raised transverse front handle (round tube r~14.2 mm) at (0.253, 0.152): the left hand wraps it with its grip axis along +Z (secondary_grip_axis), i.e. at 90 deg to the right hand. Guidebar: x 0.317..0.725, centreline y=-0.075, plane z~0.047; chain to x=0.738; the cutting run is the chain's lower edge (y~-0.119). impact_point = middle of that lower run. The bar is horizontal (bar_axis +X), 14 deg below shaft_axis.

axe.label: Axe
axe.frame: prepAxe wrapper (what the viewer loads with prep "axe"): GLB (x,y,z) -> (x, -z, y - 0.06)
axe.notes: Numbers are in the prepAxe frame (handle along +Z, blade toward -X, origin = GLB (0, 0.06, 0), the game's "hands" point 6 cm up the grip); glb_frame has the raw GLB values (handle +Y). grip_primary = GameGrip_R (0.123 m above the butt), grip_secondary = GameGrip_L (0.22 m further, 2 cm toward the poll). The handle is curved (centreline x: -0.008 at the butt, +0.022 at GLB y=0.28, +0.006 under the head), so shaft_axis is the R->L grip chord, 5.2 deg off the prepAxe +Z. Handle oval ~26 x 30 mm (r~14.7) at GameGrip_R, ~20 x 27 mm (r~11.3) at GameGrip_L. Blade edge toward -X reaches x=-0.137 (blade y 0.62-0.80 in the GLB); a pick/poll points +X. impact_point = the GLB ImpactPoint (blade edge centre).

knife.label: Knife

blade.note: 15 cm drop-point: straight spine along y=-0.012 to z=0.17, then curving to the tip on y=0; edge along +Y

knife.notes: Procedural (no model): handle along +Z centred on the origin = fist centre (z -0.055..0.055), blade z 0.061..0.211, edge toward +Y (ref_axis), spine toward -Y, tip (business end) at z=0.211. Forward (hammer) grip: blade out of the index side of the fist; for a reverse/ice-pick grip use the viewer's flip. moves.js makeKnife is close (cylinder handle r 14-16 mm, 0.15 m blade box from z 0.062 to 0.212) but its blade box has no edge side.

pistol.label: Pistol
pistol.notes: makePistol(1): barrel +Z, top +Y, muzzle (0, 0.058, 0.157). HAND-PLACEMENT FRAME, not barrel/up: shaft_axis = the grip's long axis bottom->top (pinky->index), ref_axis = toward the muzzle side, perpendicular to the grip (the fist's knuckles face forward); the barrel and up directions are in barrel_axis / up_axis. grip_primary = centre of the grip block (fist centre). Grip block 30 x 105 x 46 mm, rotation.x = -0.28 rad: its top leans BACK (-Z) and its bottom FORWARD (bottom z=+0.003, top z=-0.027), which is the opposite rake to a real pistol (real grips sweep the butt backward); worth checking in weaponModels.js.

shotgun.label: Shotgun

alt_pump_short.notes: Used by the game (main.js). Origin (no GameGrip_R node) is at the TOP of the pistol grip, under the receiver; the grip runs y -0.105..-0.03, 37 mm wide (Z) x ~68 mm front-back, raked 5.7 deg (butt back), so the fist centre is ~(0.006, -0.066, 0).

shotgun.notes: pump_shotgun.glb (what the viewer loads; the game uses pump_short.glb, see alt_pump_short). GLB frame: barrel +X, up +Y, muzzle (0.756, 0.047, 0); 1.03 m overall with the full stock (butt at x=-0.275). HAND-PLACEMENT FRAME, not barrel/up: shaft_axis = the right hand's pinky->index along the semi-pistol stock wrist (raked ~34 deg forward of vertical, estimated from the rubber grip panel edges at 27 and 42 deg, +/-8 deg), ref_axis = perpendicular to it toward the muzzle. GameGrip_R (origin) lies ON the underside surface of the wrist, so grip_primary here is an estimated fist centre inside the wrist, (-0.015, 0.010, 0), +/-1 cm. grip_secondary = GameGrip_L on the pump (child of Shotgun_Pump, pump at rest; the pump tube is centred on y=0.011), left hand grip axis along +X.
